summary: Liberty-area fire tower in Putnam County, about 80 feet tall in 1974 when a part-time observer worked it. Listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: No source gives a build date or the tower's design. The height (80 ft, 24.4 m) and the 1974 staffing come from one newspaper item quoted on the eastern lookouts page (cite 3); 24.4 m matches the record. Agency conflict: the register names the WV Division of Forestry; the eastern lookouts page header names the WV Department of Natural Resources. Left unresolved for an editor. The statewide closure sentence (cite 4) is context, not a closure date for this tower. The 1974 observer is named in the source and is a historical figure; no living person is identified.
